batch_config.name: ode_persistence_boundary_scan_v1
batch_config.purpose: Bracket the ODE persistence boundary by scanning parameters most likely to drive collapse, persistence, oscillatory persistence, or instability.

paper_alignment.paper_question: Under what conditions does the local epsilon-rho-R system sustain persistent nonzero structure rather than collapsing or washing out, and how does residue support alter that boundary?
paper_alignment.reason_for_this_batch: Current baseline runs show oscillatory persistence across tested v values. This batch is designed to force contrast and identify transition boundaries.

assumptions_for_agent: Agent should preserve all existing solver functions unless explicit incompatibility requires additive extension only.
If exact runtime schema differs, adapt field names minimally while preserving the parameter content and sweep intent.
All thresholds used by classifier must be emitted in manifest or config snapshot.
Do not hide default parameters in code; write resolved values into each run manifest.

baseline_reference.baseline_implication: Need stronger suppression / weaker support scans to reveal boundary.

initial_condition_families.name: small_epsilon
initial_condition_families.notes: Attempts to favor collapse if support is weak.

initial_condition_families.name: epsilon_biased
initial_condition_families.notes: Tests whether persistence survives favorable epsilon start only.

scan_stages.goal: Reduce support and memory persistence to search for first collapse boundary.
scan_stages.expected_value: Should reveal whether residue support is necessary for persistence in the local system.

scan_stages.goal: Increase suppression and self-limiting terms to force epsilon decay or regime transition.
scan_stages.expected_value: Tests whether stronger pressure coupling or epsilon saturation can kill persistence.

scan_stages.goal: Directly test whether the growth-driving term k can be overcome by suppression pressure.
scan_stages.expected_value: Should expose a collapse/persistence divide if one exists in the local ODE layer.

scan_stages.goal: Explicitly probe Pi = kappa/lambda as a local control diagnostic.
scan_stages.expected_value: Separates raw parameter effects from the Pi-style support/decay ratio.

minimum_success_conditions: At least one collapse_to_pressure case is observed.
At least one oscillatory_persistent case remains.
At least one parameter bracket exists where classification changes across neighboring points.
target_figures: timeseries comparison: baseline persistence vs collapse candidate
heatmap or table of regime_classification over kappa/lambda or k/beta slice
summary table showing effect of support weakening on persistence

notes_to_agent: If stage A1 already reveals a clean collapse boundary, prioritize refinement near that boundary before exhausting all later stages.
If no collapse is found in any stage, emit a diagnostic note stating that the tested local ODE region appears robustly persistent and recommend expanding parameter range before PDE work.
Negative rho values should not be silently accepted as physically meaningful; emit a flag column rho_negative_flag in summaries.
All run ids should include stage_id and initial_condition_family.
